These three fixtures are self-authored synthetic PDF/PNG sources, licensed with this repository. rich-native.pdf contains two physical text pages. rich-mixed.pdf contains a vector/caption page and a native text page. rich-scan.png is a flat nonblank RGB image exercising source-bound image preparation and OCR routing. They contain no benchmark data or gold answers. Tests use an explicitly declared offline OCR executor; these files do not qualify OCR accuracy or a native model.
